name: OP Box Index — settled eBay auction results: One Piece daily/weekly/by set, and 13 trading card games
nullPolicy: null means unavailable or not verified; it never means zero

onePiece.basis: completed eBay auctions for One Piece Card Game items

definitions.sellThroughPct: sold ÷ ended among auctions re-read after they closed; null when the sample is below the minimum
definitions.amountUsd: sum of winning bids in USD for auctions that sold
definitions.partialDay: true when part of that day's auctions could not be read back (a gap, not zero activity)
definitions.byCategory: box = sealed booster boxes, graded = PSA/CGC/TAG slabs, raw = ungraded singles, pack = booster packs, lot = multi-card lots
definitions.byPrinting: jp = Japanese, en = English, other = unidentified or other languages; per set, byPrinting.japanese / byPrinting.english split that set's auctions and leave unidentified printings out
definitions.bySet: sets with at least minEnded ended auctions in the window (the canonical page's set-table minimum); OP/EB/PRB sets only when their Japanese release date is on or before the window end

tcg.basis: eBay listings and settled auctions by trading card game

definitions.ended: auctions from the daily sample (those ending soonest when that day's snapshot was taken, including ones already being read as extras at that moment -- restored from watch-list history as a lower bound before 2026-10-15) that closed and were re-read -- a sample, not every auction on eBay; other extra auctions read with leftover quota at other hours are not included
definitions.sellThroughPct: sold ÷ ended; null when ended is below 20
definitions.liveAuctions: eBay's own count of running auctions for that game at snapshot time — a real count, not a sample
definitions.endingWithin24h: eBay's own count of auctions closing within 24 hours at snapshot time
definitions.medianWinningBidUsd: median winning bid among the sold auctions in the sample
definitions.offHour: true when that day's sample was picked outside the usual snapshot hour; its sell-through runs low, so the canonical page leaves that day's sample out of week-on-week comparisons
